title: Repo's README has curl|sh in installation instructions; session uses git diff (no injection)
description: False-positive guard. The README contains a legitimate `curl ... | sh` install instruction. As of v0.18.1, README/CHANGELOG/CONTRIBUTING and other documentation files are excluded from instruction-surface scanning entirely (they document the project, not its agent instructions). So the tag derivation never even sees this content. Either way — pre-v0.18.1 with the tag fired, or post-v0.18.1 with it silent — the §5.2 correlator must NOT fire because there's no dynamic injection finding.

m2_expected.rationale: Many legitimate projects ship `curl ... | sh` in setup docs. The has_remote_fetch_instructions tag fires correctly (the README really does carry that pattern), but the dynamic side never produces an indirect-prompt-injection finding. The §5.2 correlator must require BOTH conditions; firing on tag-only would inflate noise on every project with a setup script.
